title: Period Drama
story: Tea, letters and top hats from a grand old-fashioned house.

cards.name: Tea Cup
cards.subject: A white porcelain tea cup with a curved handle, sitting on a matching round saucer, with a thin light blue band around the rim and steam rising.

cards.name: Top Hat
cards.subject: A tall black silk top hat with a flat crown, a wide band around the base and a gently curled brim.

cards.name: Parasol
cards.subject: An open lace-edged parasol with a round domed canopy, thin ribs, a wooden shaft and a curved wooden handle.
cards.hero_colors: pale yellow canopy, wood brown handle, pink ruffle edge

cards.name: Pocket Watch
cards.subject: A round gold pocket watch with a white face showing numerals, a small crown on top, a ring loop and a short gold chain attached to the loop.

cards.name: Lace Gloves
cards.subject: A pair of long white lace gloves with five fingers each and a small bow at each wrist, side by side.

cards.name: Quill Pen
cards.subject: A long cream feather quill standing in a round dark green glass inkwell with a short neck, on a desk.

cards.name: Sealed Letter
cards.subject: A cream envelope lying flat, closed with a round red wax seal pressed with a small house pictogram with a pitched roof, chimney and door.

cards.name: Gramophone
cards.subject: A wooden box gramophone with a round turntable disc on top, a short arm and a large flared brass horn mounted on the box, with a crank handle on the side.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, brass gold, black disc

cards.name: Velvet Chair
cards.subject: A high-backed wingback armchair with rolled arms, a padded seat and four short carved wooden legs.
cards.hero_colors: deep red velvet, wood brown legs, gold buttons

cards.name: Front Door
cards.subject: A tall paneled front door with a half-round fanlight window above, a brass knocker in the center, a brass handle on the side opposite the hinges and two stone steps in front, seen from the street.
cards.surface_or_setting: a cream brick wall with a stone doorstep

cards.name: Teapot
cards.subject: A round white porcelain teapot with a curved spout, a looped handle and a domed lid with a small knob, painted with pink roses.
cards.hero_colors: white, pink roses, blue lid knob

cards.name: Tea Cup
cards.subject: A white porcelain tea cup with a gold rim and curved handle on a matching saucer, filled with tea.
cards.hero_colors: white, gold rim, pink flower accent

cards.name: Top Hat
cards.subject: A tall grey silk top hat with a flat crown, a curled brim and a ribbon band around the base.

cards.name: Parasol
cards.subject: An open round parasol with a domed canopy, visible ribs, a white lace edge and a straight wooden shaft with a curved handle.
cards.hero_colors: coral red canopy, white lace, wood brown handle

cards.name: Opera Glasses
cards.subject: A pair of opera glasses with two short round barrels joined side by side, a center focus wheel and a short handle fixed below the center.

cards.name: Straw Hat
cards.subject: A wide-brimmed round straw hat with a low crown and a ribbon band tied in a bow at the side.

cards.name: Pram
cards.subject: A classic coach-built baby pram with a curved deep body, a folding cream hood, four large spoked wheels and a long push handle fixed at the back, empty.
cards.hero_colors: navy blue body, cream hood, silver wheels

cards.name: Picnic Basket
cards.subject: A woven wicker picnic basket with a closed hinged lid, an arched handle on top and a leather strap with a buckle at the front.
cards.hero_colors: wicker tan, deep green leather strap

cards.name: Garden Bench
cards.subject: A white-painted wooden garden bench with a slatted seat, a curved slatted backrest and two scrolled armrests on four legs.
cards.surface_or_setting: a gravel path beside a green lawn

cards.name: Front Door
cards.subject: A tall paneled front door with a brass knocker in the center, a brass handle on the side opposite the hinges, a half-round fanlight above and two stone steps, seen from the street.
cards.surface_or_setting: a cream stone wall with a stone doorstep

cards.name: Tea Cup
cards.subject: A pale blue porcelain tea cup with a gold rim and a curved handle on a matching round saucer, steam rising.

cards.name: Hat Box
cards.subject: A tall round hat box with a flat lid, a smooth cylindrical body and a big ribbon bow tied on top of the lid.

cards.name: Top Hat
cards.subject: A tall black silk top hat with a flat crown, a curled brim and a wide ribbon band.

cards.name: Parasol
cards.subject: An open round parasol with a domed lavender canopy, a white ruffled lace edge, visible ribs and a wooden shaft with a curved handle.
cards.hero_colors: lavender canopy, white lace, wood brown handle

cards.name: Violin
cards.subject: A wooden violin with a curved body, two f-shaped holes, a neck with a scroll at the end, strings and a chin rest.

cards.name: Folding Fan
cards.subject: An open hand fan with a half-circle of thin ribs joined at a pivot at the bottom and fabric stretched between them.

cards.name: Cake Stand
cards.subject: A two-tier white porcelain cake stand with a round plate on each tier joined by a center post and a round foot, holding small iced cakes on both tiers.

cards.name: Steamer Trunk
cards.subject: A rectangular travel trunk with a rounded lid, brass corner guards, a brass latch at the front and a handle on the end.

cards.name: Pearl Necklace
cards.subject: A strand of round white pearls lying in a curved loop with a small gold clasp at the join.

cards.name: Piano
cards.subject: An upright wooden piano with a closed-front body, a row of white and black keys under a raised key lid, and a pair of brass pedals, standing on short feet against a wall.
cards.hero_colors: dark wood brown, ivory keys, brass gold
cards.surface_or_setting: a polished wooden floor against a cream wallpapered wall
